scripts.build: npm run build -w @config-diff/core && npm run build -w @config-diff/cli && npm run build -w @config-diff/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @config-diff/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm test -w @config-diff/core && npm run build -w @config-diff/cli && npm test -w @config-diff/cli && npm test -w @config-diff/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @config-diff/core && npm run typecheck -w @config-diff/cli && npm run typecheck -w @config-diff/web
